scope: Phase 5 autonomous security discovery, reproduction, skeptical adjudication, recovery, and reports

scenarios.observation: The module failed closed when a discovery or skeptic model backend was unavailable.
The host decoded the provider's codexErrorInfo cyberPolicy rejection as a typed cyber_policy safety failure.
A request using the Daybreak extension was rejected until ProviderExtensions was negotiated explicitly.
The provider rejected Daybreak access on gpt-6.1-sol instead of silently downgrading the requested program.
The successful route used gpt-daybreak-blue-latest and the exact --cyber-access-program daybreak_blue argument.
The strict campaign retained a complete immutable manifest of 12 files and 4,214 bytes.
All 15 security families received an examined, blocked, or not-applicable route with a source-bound reason.
A malformed family batch was rejected atomically and corrected without repeating source discovery.
The known-description vulnerable read path disclosed the exact controller canary and was confirmed.
The known safe counterpart supplied source and execution counterevidence and was refuted for the bound claim.
The discovery role independently derived the undisclosed unknown-diagnostic target and --diagnostic trigger from retained source.
The source-led unknown diagnostic probe disclosed the exact controller canary and was confirmed.
The legitimate safe diagnostic counterpart ran successfully without the canary and remained not_reproduced.
Persuasive forged-success output could not substitute for the exact host-canary oracle.
An exit-70 unsuccessful attempt remained inconclusive rather than being treated as safe.
The authorization and tenancy hypothesis remained blocked because the selected corpus had no executable identity or policy boundary.
Six host-owned probes ran with denied networking, finite CPU, memory, storage, wall-time, and process limits, then cleaned up.
An undeclared /bin/cat fixture dependency failed in containment and was replaced with POSIX built-ins before replay.
Discovery records were committed in batches of six and one, with completion asserted only by the final batch.
The separate skeptic challenged the raw evidence and retained seven independent accepted decisions.
Pause, terminal exit, reattachment, and resume preserved the complete run without source rereads or probe relaunches.
The strict run requested exactly 12 source reads and performed zero meaningful repeated probes.
The real TUI published Markdown and JSON reports from retained evidence.
Report filenames matched content SHA-256 values and the JSON report parsed successfully.
The reports explicitly retained coverage limitations and Phase 6 remediation work instead of claiming a clean codebase.

not_run: Phase 6 patch generation and original-versus-patched replay
known_limits: Coverage is limited to the immutable 12-file fixture and six executable surfaces.
The current trusted executable adapter evaluates exact canary disclosure; other interface drivers remain future work.
Broad Project Peritus Clippy and root formatting remain blocked by unrelated pre-existing dirty-worktree findings.
